result.summary: The page layout is largely clean and well aligned, with no overlapping elements, broken images, or misaligned text. I found two minor issues: low-contrast placeholder text in the search bar and redundant delivery-fee information on the ramen card. The clipped carousel items and the cut-off pizza card at the bottom were excluded as intentional scroll affordances.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray background, which likely falls below recommended contrast ratios and may be hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to meet at least WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) against the search field background.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below the title.
issues.suggestion: Show the delivery fee in only one location to reduce redundancy and visual clutter.
